entries.dialogueText: "But it will be a huge burden for our government to provide for so many people."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes. It will have serious complica..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. It will have serious complications in the future. However, it is also true that this will reflect very positively in the upcoming elections. It's what the public asked for, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will have control over the coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will have control over the council, which will have control over the media. You see where I'm going with this..."
entries.menuText: "We will have control over the council, which will have control over the media. You see where I'm going with this..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It will definitely help us have an..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will definitely help us have an influence on new media. So how will you structure this Supreme Council of Sordish Radio and Television?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course. It will be the perfect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. It will be the perfect tool to manipulate the public."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want them to be independent, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want them to be independent, and only regulate the content according to some standards."
entries.menuText: "I want them to be independent, and only regulate the content according to some standards."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah...""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I very much support your decision..."
entries.dialogueText: "I very much support your decision to form a regulatory body for radio and television. Television is the future. It's great that we all understand this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
Petr Vectern
Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Interested to see how the Oligarch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interested to see how the Oligarchs would react."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, we both respect your decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we both respect your decisions, Anton."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So... You decided not to sign anyt..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... You decided not to sign anything."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think it's the right time.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think it's the right time."
entries.menuText: "I don't think it's the right time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I won't force laws like Soll did...."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't force laws like Soll did. It's the Assembly's job to make laws."
entries.menuText: "I won't force laws like Soll did. It's the Assembly's job to make laws."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. So what?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. So what?"
entries.menuText: "Yes. So what?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""N-Nothing.""
entries.dialogueText: "N-Nothing."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It's funny you think that way. Usi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's funny you think that way. Using your powers for good could have helped with the next elections."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not in Sordland. But I respect you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not in Sordland. But I respect your ideals, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Let's not question the President,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not question the President, Petr."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But now that everything's settled,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But now that everything's settled, I should get to work. We'll catch up soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at his watch."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at his watch.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We actually have six more minutes.""
entries.dialogueText: "We actually have six more minutes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But very well. Let's call it here.""
entries.dialogueText: "But very well. Let's call it here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you both.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you both."
entries.menuText: "Thank you both."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Lucian.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Lucian."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Petr.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Petr."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Petr."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Approving the new Semi-Autonomous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Approving the new Semi-Autonomous Zone could be the most major decision you've made today."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nobody but you could have done som..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody but you could have done something like this, Anton."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, this will alienate all of you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, this will alienate all of your supporters who harbor even slightly nationalist sentiments."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Bergia gets to choose its own gove..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bergia gets to choose its own governor now. Let's hope whoever they elect doesn't steer them too far away from the central government."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They will have to respect the new..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will have to respect the new structure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You disapprove?""
entries.dialogueText: "You disapprove?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was aware of that when I made my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was aware of that when I made my decision, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr took a close look at the paper..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr took a close look at the papers I signed.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not at all, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Approving the abolishment of the S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Approving the abolishment of the Special Zone could be the most major decision you've made today."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""No more governor of Bergia, just c..."
entries.dialogueText: "No more governor of Bergia, just cities with mayors like everywhere else. Let's hope that makes the locals feel more like they're part of this country."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nobody but you could have done som..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody but you could have done something like this, Anton."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""While the moderates of the Bludish..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the moderates of the Bludish movement and regular citizens will likely be supportive of this..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The Bludish nationalists and the m..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bludish nationalists and the mainstream democratic freedom movement will be furious."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Assembly will not pass it anyw..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly will not pass it anyway. I'd rather not take a popularity hit at this stage. I won't sign it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Enacting a new value added tax wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enacting a new value added tax will increase our generated tax revenues but we have to understand the public reaction to a new tax levy."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""A loss in public opinion is guaran..."
entries.dialogueText: "A loss in public opinion is guaranteed as the consumers and the economy adjusts to this change."

entries.dialogueText: "There is a high chance this might influence the average citizen more negatively."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We better put the newly generated..."
entries.dialogueText: "We better put the newly generated money to good use."
